title: receiveTypingIndicators: server-side suppression, not client-side
description: The `receiveTypingIndicators` flag is enforced server-side before delivery, not by instructing clients to ignore events they receive. This is correct because clients cannot be trusted to suppress, and server-side enforcement means the preference is respected regardless of client implementation. Both draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md (Chat/typing server behavior section) and draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md (ChatTypingEvent delivery section) specify the suppression as a server MUST, not a client SHOULD.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
